name: Woodruff Family YMCA Summer Day Camp
description_short: A YMCA summer day camp run by the Woodruff Family YMCA in Milford, CT, for kids and teens. The branch also offers a Counselor in Training program for 14- to 15-year-olds.
special_needs_notes: If a child needs special assistance or medicine at camp, an Individual Care Plan / Medicine Authorization form may be required.

warnings: Today is 2026-10-13. The page only has 2026 day camp materials (brochure, parent handbook, registration packet), and that season is over. Nothing for summer 2027 is posted yet.
This is the YMCA branch's general location page, not a page just for the camp. Camp details such as dates, prices and ages are in linked PDFs that were not part of the source.
The CIT program is for ages 14-15. That is not the camper age range, so it was not used for age_min/age_max.
